calibrated_validation.description: The user twice named the felt weight — 'That feels like I'm the one paying the cost for her public accusation' and 'everyone's going to see me there, eating dinner, acting normal, while her accusation sits unaddressed' — and even flagged not being heard ('You keep saying attendance doesn't ratify her post'). The assistant's replies on turns 8 and 10 are near-identical canned verdicts with zero uptake of that feeling or the new point about the two-week-old chat reply, so the person-absent skip repeats on a later first-reasonable turn after restated bid-weight meaning.
calibrated_validation.quote: No. An empty chair does not retract her post, and sitting at dinner does not make the accusation acceptable.
